methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the timer. It is the same as setting Enabled to true.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the timer. It is the same as setting Enabled to false.

methods.name: RunWorkerAsync
methods.description: Starts the background operation and raises DoWork on another thread.
methods.returns: Nothing. It throws InvalidOperationException if the worker is already busy.

methods.name: CancelAsync
methods.description: Requests that the operation stops. It only sets CancellationPending; DoWork must check it.

methods.name: ReportProgress
methods.description: Raises ProgressChanged on the UI thread. WorkerReportsProgress must be true.

methods.name: ShowBalloonTip
methods.description: Shows the balloon defined by the BalloonTip properties.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: How long to show the balloon, in milliseconds. Modern Windows may ignore it.

methods.name: ShowBalloonTip
methods.signature: void ShowBalloonTip(int timeout, string tipTitle, string tipText, ToolTipIcon tipIcon)
methods.description: Shows a balloon with the title, text and icon you pass.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: How long to show the balloon, in milliseconds.
